mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns; FEDFUNDS below 0.25% is a key threshold for this signal.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in the next 20 trading days when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.16%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% in the past 3 months signals economic stress and leads to negative S&P 500 20-day returns as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in the next 20 trading days when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) and strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 20-day returns through elevated corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in the next 20 trading days when UNRATE < 5.0% and INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) triggers monetary tightening expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 20-day returns as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in the next 20 trading days when CPIAUCSL exceeds 200.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 570 thousand units signal strong consumer demand for housing, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 20-day returns due to economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in the next 20 trading days when HOUST exceeds 570.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 index level indicates robust manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day returns as corporate profits rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in the next 20 trading days when INDPRO exceeds 100.

mechanism_narrative: A recent decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.01% over the past 5 days signals immediate monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in the next 5 trading days despite FEDFUNDS declining by more than 0.01% in the past 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month period of industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 index level indicates strong manufacturing expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in the next 60 trading days despite INDPRO remaining above 100 for the past 3 months.
